correctness.rationale: Exact Q(sqrt5) coordinate/dot-product construction and K12 polynomial identities recover all 15 eigenvalues; rational brackets give condition >875 at degree 12. Standalone integer Bareiss/Sylvester checks prove positive-definiteness of 200 M-qI and 3qI-M at exactly 490 other full-rank degrees, with certified entry errors <2/2^48, implying condition <875 there. Analytic Laplace integral controls every degree >=500 by strict diagonal dominance (<0.99 offdiagonal row sum), condition <199; therefore all quantifiers and the unique maximum are proved. Finite tests alone are not used as an infinite proof.
